scores.claim_text: F-22 Raptor named as a major Aeronautics program; F-22 sustainment / post-production support implicit forward-revenue contributor.
supports: pentagon_jbook(PE 0207138F F-22A Squadrons RDT&E) = FUNDED_STEADY at FY24 cutoff ($640.1M FY24) — modernization line is healthy
pentagon_jbook(PE F02200 F-22A Procurement P-40) = UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR at FY24 cutoff ($0M FY24, n_consecutive_unfunded=1) — production / post-production procurement is zero
pentagon_jbook(program_name='F-22A') matched both, primary returned the UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR signal
scores.interpretation: MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY. The F-22A modernization RDT&E line (0207138F) is well-funded ($640M FY24) so the sustainment / upgrade thesis is intact, but the AF Aircraft Procurement P-40 line F02200 (post-production support equipment & facilities) is zeroed at FY24. F-22 is not the largest LMT program (modest share of Aeronautics behind F-35), and the modernization line carries most of LMT's F-22 forward revenue — so the procurement-line zero is a real signal but not existential. Heuristic #8 applies: when a company claims a *production* line, the P-40 line is the right reference; this confirms F-22 production is closed (consistent with longstanding Pentagon posture). LMT does not explicitly claim new F-22 production, so framing it as MODERATE rather than SEVERE is calibrated.
